title: Career paragraph frame
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y8 lesson 29 (Pupil PDF worksheet: career paragraph frame)
intro: Lesson 29: Reasons and intentions: why I want this job. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Intention
points: Actions are by intentions (Bukhari and Muslim)
Work with the intention to help and earn halal

arabic.text:
أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُمَرِّضًا لِأَنَّ العَمَلَ فِي المُسْتَشْفَى مُفِيدٌ.
أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَاعِدَ المَرْضَى.
العَمَلُ صَعْبٌ لٰكِنَّهُ مُهِمٌّ جِدًّا.

frame.label: Link

questions.q: Give a reason and a purpose for being a teacher.
questions.a: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُعَلِّمًا لِأَنَّنِي أُحِبُّ القِرَاءَةَ، وَلِأُعَلِّمَ الأَطْفَالَ.

questions.q: Career paragraph in the portal response box (five sentences): the job, a reason, a purpose, one challenge with لٰكِنْ, and your intention.
questions.a: Five sentences with لِأَنَّ، لِـ، لٰكِنْ used correctly

questions.q: Extend: read your paragraph aloud for a partner to give one improvement.

questions.a: A) To help people. لِـ + verb = in order to.
No: halal work, helping people and good intention matter more.
